statements.sql: select * from `users` where not exists (select * from `roles` inner join `user_role` on `roles`.`id` = `user_role`.`role_id` where `users`.`id` = `user_role`.`user_id` and `name` = 'User') and `email` = 'superadmin@gmail.com' and `users`.`deleted_at` is null limit 1

select `roles`.*, `user_role`.`user_id` as `pivot_user_id`, `user_role`.`role_id` as `pivot_role_id` from `roles` inner join `user_role` on `roles`.`id` = `user_role`.`role_id` where `user_role`.`user_id` in ('daca1f59-97a0-46b3-85a9-adef51c1d1b7')
select * from `users` where `email` = 'superadmin@gmail.com' and `users`.`deleted_at` is null limit 1
select * from `banned_users` where `banned_user` = 'daca1f59-97a0-46b3-85a9-adef51c1d1b7' order by `created_at` desc limit 1

select `roles`.*, `roles_permissions`.`permission_id` as `pivot_permission_id`, `roles_permissions`.`role_id` as `pivot_role_id` from `roles` inner join `roles_permissions` on `roles`.`id` = `roles_permissions`.`role_id` where `roles_permissions`.`permission_id` = 1

select `roles`.*, `user_role`.`user_id` as `pivot_user_id`, `user_role`.`role_id` as `pivot_role_id` from `roles` inner join `user_role` on `roles`.`id` = `user_role`.`role_id` where `user_role`.`user_id` = 'daca1f59-97a0-46b3-85a9-adef51c1d1b7'
